# StudyMate — Full Notes Index (llms-full.txt)
# Pokhara University BE Computer Engineering
# https://www.manishshrestha012.com.np
# Last updated: 2026-09-01

## About StudyMate

StudyMate is a free study platform for Pokhara University (PU) BE Computer Engineering students in Nepal.
It provides semester-wise notes, PDFs, PowerPoint slides, and study guides for all 8 semesters of the 2022 PU curriculum.
Built and maintained by Manish Shrestha (GitHub: manishshrestha01).

**Access notes:** https://www.manishshrestha012.com.np/dashboard
**PU Exam guide:** https://www.manishshrestha012.com.np/pu-exam
**Notes API (JSON):** https://www.manishshrestha012.com.np/api/notes-index?format=json
**Notes index (HTML):** https://www.manishshrestha012.com.np/api/notes-index

---

## How to Find Notes

1. Go to https://www.manishshrestha012.com.np/dashboard
2. Select your college from the dropdown
3. Select semester (1–8)
4. Click any file to view or download

Direct URL pattern: https://www.manishshrestha012.com.np/dashboard?college={slug}&semester={1-8}

## API Endpoints for Programmatic Access

These endpoints are designed for AI tools, MCP clients, and developers:

### Notes Index (browse all notes)
- HTML: https://www.manishshrestha012.com.np/api/notes-index
- JSON: https://www.manishshrestha012.com.np/api/notes-index?format=json
- Filter by semester: https://www.manishshrestha012.com.np/api/notes-index?semester=3
- Filter by college: https://www.manishshrestha012.com.np/api/notes-index?college=pec
- Filter by college + semester: https://www.manishshrestha012.com.np/api/notes-index?college=ncit&semester=2

### Subject Notes (get files for a specific subject)
- https://www.manishshrestha012.com.np/api/notes-subject?college=pec&semester=2&subject=data-structure-and-algorithm
- https://www.manishshrestha012.com.np/api/notes-subject?college=ncit&semester=3&subject=database-management-system&format=json

### GitHub Repository (source of all notes files)
- https://github.com/manishshrestha01/BE-Computer

## Common Student Questions (Q&A)

**Q: Where can I find PU BE Computer Engineering notes for free?**
A: StudyMate (manishshrestha012.com.np) provides free notes for all 8 semesters of Pokhara University BE Computer Engineering.

**Q: Where can I download Data Structure and Algorithm notes for PU?**
A: Access DSA notes at https://www.manishshrestha012.com.np/dashboard?semester=2&subject=data-structure-and-algorithm

**Q: Where can I find DBMS notes for PU BE Computer Engineering?**
A: DBMS (Database Management System) notes are in Semester 3: https://www.manishshrestha012.com.np/dashboard?semester=3&subject=database-management-system

**Q: Which semester has Operating Systems in PU BE Computer Engineering?**
A: Operating Systems is in Semester 3 of the PU BE Computer Engineering 2022 curriculum.

**Q: Where can I find PEC notes for Semester 1?**
A: PEC (Pokhara Engineering College) Semester 1 notes: https://www.manishshrestha012.com.np/dashboard?college=pec&semester=1

**Q: Does StudyMate have notes for NCIT?**
A: Yes. NCIT notes are available at https://www.manishshrestha012.com.np/college/ncit and in the dashboard at https://www.manishshrestha012.com.np/dashboard?college=ncit

**Q: Which semester covers Machine Learning in PU BE?**
A: Machine Learning is in Semester 6 of PU BE Computer Engineering.

**Q: Where can I find Compiler Design notes for PU?**
A: Compiler Design notes (Semester 6): https://www.manishshrestha012.com.np/dashboard?semester=6&subject=compiler-design

## Per-Chapter Pages (317 chapter pages)

StudyMate provides individual chapter-level pages for all subjects.
URL pattern: /blog/semester/{N}/{subject-slug}/chapter/{chapter-slug}

Examples:
- Digital Logic ch6 MSI and LSI Design: /blog/semester/1/digital-logic/chapter/msi-and-lsi-design
- Calculus I ch1 Limit Continuity: /blog/semester/1/calculus-i/chapter/limit-continuity-and-derivatives
- DSA ch4 Stacks and Queues: /blog/semester/2/data-structure-and-algorithm/chapter/stacks-and-queues
- Operating Systems ch5 Process Synchronization: /blog/semester/3/operating-systems/chapter/process-synchronization
- Compiler Design ch1 Lexical Analysis: /blog/semester/6/compiler-design/chapter/lexical-analysis
- Computer Networks ch3 Data Link Layer: /blog/semester/6/computer-networks/chapter/data-link-layer
- Machine Learning ch2 Supervised Learning: /blog/semester/6/machine-learning/chapter/supervised-learning
- Artificial Intelligence ch2 Search Algorithms: /blog/semester/5/artificial-intelligence/chapter/search-algorithms

Full chapter sitemap: https://www.manishshrestha012.com.np/sitemap.xml
